text:
alex.k: heads-up — saw steady memory growth on long-chat VMs, looks like KV cache isn't reclaiming large slots. running a small sim of slot utilization and wanted quick feedback on tuning and compaction tradeoffs.

priya.n: can you paste the pprof snapshot? is this the same regression we saw last month?

alex.k: quick snapshot commands i used:
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://metrics/pprof/kv_cache/1234 > kv.pb
pprof -pdf kv.pb > kv.pdf
```
Top lines show many 64KB slot allocations in `slot_new` that never free — lots of long-lived entries pinned by long contexts.

mike.s: long-context requests keep pinning large KV entries. we saw similar behavior when block_size=64KB and seq_len distribution had many >8k tokens.

samuel: what does the sim say about smaller block sizes? any visible perf hit on hits/latency?

alex.k: ran a 24h sim with mixed short+long trace (staging replay). highlights:
- block=64KB: frag_ratio ~18%, eviction thrash ~0.9%, peak mem +1.4GB
- block=16KB: frag_ratio ~9%, eviction thrash ~2.2%, peak mem +800MB
- block=4KB: frag_ratio ~6%, eviction thrash ~6.8%, peak mem +600MB
latency delta negligible for batch sizes <=8, small throughput drop at 4KB under high concurrent requests.

(sim snippet)
```python
# run_sim.py (toy)
# generates slot histogram and frag_ratio per-bucket
```

priya.n: interesting tradeoff — smaller block size reduces frag but increases eviction churn. adaptive per-model block sizing might help.

mike.s: proposal idea: two-tier allocator. keep large slots (for >8k contexts) in a cold pool that is compacted infrequently. normal traffic uses small-slot pool. compact cold pool with a bounded rate (background job).

alex.k: +1. also a "rolling eviction" heuristic to prioritize compaction/eviction in high-frag buckets. rough pseudo:
```text
if free_frag_ratio(bucket) > 0.25 and bucket_active_age(bucket) > 10m:
  schedule_compact(bucket)
```

perf-bot: perf-regression-alert: kv_cache_mem_growth increased 12% after deploy (deploy/2026-03-10). details: https://perf/alerts/123

samuel: we need better observability: add per-bucket metrics: `frag_ratio`, `active_slots_by_size`, `compaction_runtime_ms`, `compaction_backlog`. also emit eviction-thrash rate.

priya.n: and test interaction with batching heuristics — batching tends to read contiguous KV spans; fragmentation can increase read scatter and hurt batching efficiency. include batching workload in sim.

mike.s: canary plan: run background compactor on a Dedicated pool first, with a compaction token-bucket (budget ms/sec) to avoid latency spikes. also provide a flag to force-only-on-idle to reduce tail impact.

alex.k: i'll open an RFC with sim artifacts and canary plan. quick action list: 
- add metrics (samuel)
- implement prototype background compactor + token budget (mike.s)
- run long-context replay in staging + measure batching interaction (priya.n)

will post RFC link here once created. thanks all :thumbsup:
